question.text: A PMS FI portfolio with duration 6 and 15% exposure to high-yield bonds faces:

explanation.text: The Logic: Multi-dimensional: rate risk (duration-driven) + credit risk (high-yield) + liquidity + reinvestment. All active. The Trap: Simplistic views miss composite risks. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 17, 19. Manager's Pro-Tip: Risk budgeting: allocate risk across each dimension; don't concentrate on one source.
